title: Dream Condo in Desirable West End!
description:
✔️ West End location — near Vanderbilt and Centennial Park
✔️ Minutes to Downtown, Music Row, and The Parthenon
✔️ 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom — sleeps up to 4
✔️ Open-concept living with smart TV
✔️ Full kitchen with breakfast bar
✔️ Garage parking and in-unit laundry

The space
• Modern West End condo with music-inspired décor
• Open living room with smart TV and comfortable seating
• Full kitchen with breakfast bar and café table for 2
• Bright bedroom plus additional sleeping in the living room
• Perfect for couples, business travelers, and weekend getaways

🌅 Indoor & Outdoor Living
• Open-concept living room with smart TV
• Contemporary, music-inspired interiors
• City views
• Bright, modern condo layout

🛏️ Bedrooms & Sleeping Arrangements (Sleeps 4)
• This home includes 1 bedroom and 1 bathroom.
• Bedroom 1 — Queen bed
• Living Room — Full-size futon (sleeps 2)
• Bath — Single vanity with shower/tub combo

🍳 Kitchen & Dining
• Full kitchen with stainless appliances and basic cookware/serveware
• Breakfast bar seating
• Café table seating for 2
• Cookware, bakeware, dishes, utensils, and glassware provided
• Salt, pepper, and cooking oil are not provided

🏖️ What's Included
• Private washer and dryer
• High-speed WiFi
• Smart TV
• We provide bedding, towels, and a small starter set of essentials

📍 Location Highlights
• West End near Vanderbilt University
• Walk or drive to Centennial Park and The Parthenon
• Close to Hillsboro Village and Elliston Place dining
• Minutes to Music Row, Downtown Nashville, and Broadway
• Easy access to restaurants, shopping, and live music

🚗 Parking, Safety & Notes
• Parking: Garage parking for 1 vehicle; additional street parking may be available (first come, first served)
• Elevator: There is an elevator in the building. It’s operated and maintained by building management and is typically available; any maintenance or outages are outside our control. Stairs are required if the elevator is unavailable.
• Pet Policy: No pets are permitted at this home. If evidence of a pet is found, additional cleaning may be required.
• Check in is at 4:00 PM and checkout is at 10:00 AM.
